original_hook: 🎯 When a token plunges -51% in a day, traders usually assume heavy spot distribution. The 1H tape on $IOST shows a very different mechanical footprint. During the breakdown to $0.001026, hourly volume spiked to 2.71B tokens ($30.69M USDT 24h volume). Right after hitting that low, hourly volume dropped over 80% while price compressed tightly between $0.001017 and $0.001054. That signature—extreme volume expansion immediately followed by volume exhaustion—points to an automated long liquidation cascade running out of forced market sells against passive limit bids at $0.0010, rather than active spot dumping.
